sanskrit_verse: यत्र विप्रो न विद्वान् स्यात् क्षत्रियं तत्र योजयेत् । वैश्यं वा धर्मशास्त्रज्ञं शूद्रं यत्नेन वर्जयेत् ॥
transliteration: yatra vipro na vidvān syāt kṣatriyaṃ tatra yojayet | vaiśyaṃ vā dharmaśāstrajñaṃ śūdraṃ yatnena varjayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Where a Brahmin lacks scriptural knowledge, there shall a Kshatriya be appointed; or else a Vaishya who knows Dharma-shastras, while a Shudra must always be excluded with care.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from capacity in Dharma, not birth alone
Causation aligns with competence and consciousness, not lineage
Capacity-based responsibility determines eligibility for societal roles
Restoration logic demands alignment of role with inner qualification
Consciousness alignment ensures lawful function through rightful placement
executable_legal_axioms: IF (citizen.role == 'Brahmin') AND (citizen.dharma_knowledge == FALSE) AND (no_available_kshatriya == TRUE) THEN ASSIGN(role = 'Vaishya') WHERE (dharma_shastras_known == TRUE)
IF (citizen.varna == 'Shudra') THEN EXCLUDE(citizen) FROM (ritual_duty_execution, judicial_advisory, scriptural_governance)
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning appointment to scripturally defined offices, the Supreme Court shall verify that role assignment aligns with demonstrated Dharma-capacity rather than hereditary claim. A Brahmin lacking Vedic knowledge is disqualified ipso facto, and replacement by qualified Kshatriya or Vaishya is mandatory. Shudras are categorically excluded from scriptural governance roles.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that right action arises from right knowledge. Where knowledge is absent, authority lapses automatically. Sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) dictates replacement by next qualified varna. Responsibility is proportional to capacity; exclusion is not punitive but structural—ensuring alignment of consciousness with duty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Reassign unqualified Brahmin to learning path until dharma-knowledge is verified
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Qualified Kshatriya/Vaishya assumes duties without resentment or displacement trauma
Capacity Restoration: Shudra individuals directed toward skill-appropriate paths aligned with svadharma
Integrity Reintegration: All displaced parties offered dharmic realignment counseling
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores rightful order through consciousness-aligned capacity. There is no punishment—only realignment. Reality itself adjudicates through Dharma.
